text:
maya: I pushed a docs PR updating the private installer networking section — port matrix + small CLI flag fix. Can someone review before merge? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 :eyes:

eli: Thanks, will take a look. What's the CLI change?

maya: It's tiny — the installer flags doc had `--airgapped` but the CLI expects `--airgap`. Also clarified required open ports and KMS agent default port (9000). Added explicit HSM PKCS#11 path example.

eli: Can you paste the ports snippet here?

maya: ```
Required ports (private deployment behind NAT):
- 443/tcp (control plane)
- 2379/tcp (etcd, optional for on-prem)
- 10250/tcp (kubelet)
- 9000/tcp (kms-agent)
- 11211/tcp (cache layer, optional)
```

raul: Heads-up — add note for customers using strict egress that KMS agent needs outbound access to artifacts.url.redwood (443). Also mention HSM PKCS11 ld path default: `/var/lib/pkcs11/libhsm.so` (some HSM vendors differ).

sre-jen: Also add a short troubleshooting blurb for iptables vs nftables ordering with Calico (seen this in onprem installs) — a one-liner and link to runbook.

docs-bot: Link-checker: found broken link in docs/installer/airgap -> replaced with /installer/air-gapped.

maya: Great catches — will update PR with the `--airgap` correction, ports matrix, outbound artifact note, HSM path example, and add nftables/Calico troubleshooting line. I'll ping again when done. :thumbsup:

eli: LGTM after edits. Thanks!
